report.summary: Checkout-service exhibited a 1.2× rise in resident memory and a 1.6× spike in CPU usage during the 3‑hour window, accompanied by four OutOfMemoryError logs and sixteen GC overhead limit warnings. These symptoms point to a memory‑related issue, likely a leak or sudden load increase.

likely_causes.title: Memory leak in checkout-service causing heap exhaustion
likely_causes.rationale: Repeated OutOfMemoryError and GC overhead warnings, coupled with a sustained rise in resident memory, strongly suggest a memory leak.
